guidance: We have delivered 10.4 million devices in the quarter and remain on track to exceed our full year guidance of 36 million devices.
In parallel, we're pursuing a significant scale-up opportunity in both these segments, which we expect to unfold over the next 36 months.
capex: We will focus on 5 areas: ramping up our newly commissioned capacity; exceeding our full year device guidance; advancing our platforms in emergency use in oncology; progressing the Consumer Electronics and Semiconductor
Is there a possibility that our capex for the Consumer Electronics as a start could be in excess of INR100 crores?
risks: These statements are not the guarantees of future performance, and it may involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
Second, gross margins recovered to 60%, about 70 basis points higher than a year ago, following the cost pressures we highlighted in quarter 1.
focus: The global GLP-1 market is also entering a significant phase of transition.
From the outset, we are focused on building our own IP-led platforms, creating differentiated solutions for our customers and patients.
We are also extending our platforms beyond GLP-1 into new therapeutic areas with a particular focus on emergency use and oncology.
quals: Amit Sanghvi: Eye applicator has just completed qualifications.
We've just installed the Neo line, which we are now getting into qualifications next week.
And on semiconductor, start qualification with customers and then start commercial shipments from Q4 FY27.

about: The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of injection moulded precision plastic components, sub-assemblies for various requirements of Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM). It also offers secondary operations in plastics like vacuum metalizing, hot stamping, and ultrasonic welding. Its manufacturing facilities are at Savli and Halol, Vadodara, Gujarat. [1]
